title: Calling a non-static method directly from static main
answer: A static `main` method has no implicit object instance, so it cannot directly call an instance method as though `this` existed. The code must first create or obtain an object and invoke the method through that reference. Attempting `instanceMethod()` directly from static `main` causes the compiler error commonly summarized as 'non-static method cannot be referenced from a static context'.
